question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove the mechanics, but the product tradeoff between recoverability and a clear terminal operator state needs explicit maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Accept Pending Deferral After Pacing Fix
options.body: Merge once the no-op pacing bug is fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing lands.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed Until Ledger
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery-ledger work defines operator visibility and reconciliation.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API path that exposes deferred ambiguous rows before changing them to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Pending Deferral After Pacing Fix
recommendation.body: Merge once the no-op pacing bug is fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing lands.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses recent outbound recovery work where this person appears as co-author and the operator-facing queue-state behavior still needs product acceptance.
